name: synth-r1
setup: mkdir -p /content/work /content/synth && tar -xzf /content/synth_rasam1_pack.tgz -C /content/work && pip install -q rapidfuzz && python -c "import os; from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; t = open('/content/.hf_token').read().strip() if os.path.exists('/content/.hf_token') else None; snapshot_download('calfa-ai/RASAM-1', repo_type='dataset', cache_dir='/content/hf/hub', token=t)" && free -g && df -h /content | tail -1

runs.label: synth_rasam1
runs.cmd: cd /content/work/tadqiq && TADQIQ_HUB=/content/hf/hub TADQIQ_MAIN=/content/work TADQIQ_SYNTH=/content/synth PYTHONPATH=src python -u scripts/synthetic_rasam1.py
